mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_notice ( receiver_id, event_key, notice_type, title, content, send_channel, send_status, send_time, is_read ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{eventKey}, #{noticeType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{sendChannel}, #{sendStatus}, #{sendTime}, #{isRead} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, receiver_id AS receiverId, event_key AS eventKey, notice_type AS noticeType, title, content, send_channel AS sendChannel, send_status AS sendStatus, send_time AS sendTime, is_read AS isRead FROM message_notice WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, receiver_id AS receiverId, event_key AS eventKey, notice_type AS noticeType, title, content, send_channel AS sendChannel, send_status AS sendStatus, send_time AS sendTime, is_read AS isRead FROM message_notice WHERE event_key = #{eventKey} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, receiver_id AS receiverId, event_key AS eventKey, notice_type AS noticeType, title, content, send_channel AS sendChannel, send_status AS sendStatus, send_time AS sendTime, is_read AS isRead FROM message_notice WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE message_notice SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
